title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance — Episode6 The Same Cherry Blossoms But...

meta.Episode: Episode6 — The Same Cherry Blossoms But...
meta.Event Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It might be better that I don't find her here, but if something like that other time happens again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, have you seen Mafuyu?
We were out doing something together and thought she might've come here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If she did come here, we'd definitely know it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was worried that something was bothering her and decided to come here, but I'm glad I was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, where on earth could she be?
I hope she isn't hurt or anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You care about Mafuyu and the others quite a lot, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess I do.
We make music together and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, you know...?
I feel like we get along pretty well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'd be nice if you could all stay together like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can keep making songs and go on trips like this from time to time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, I should head back and find Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that I know she wasn't in SEKAI, she's officially a little girl that's lost...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should go back to where we got separated and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We came to tell you that we found Mafuyu wandering around over there. Kanade should be with her now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does she always end up doing this, honestly...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! Do you know how much time we spent looking for you?! Don't wander off on us like that, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You are...? O-Okay...
As long as you understand...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Were you looking at the cherry blossoms?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I couldn't get myself to turn away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't understand. It's like cherry blossoms look prettier than they always have...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get that this tree's really huge, but they just look like regular old cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The last time I saw cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: New Student A
rows.Line: Look at those cherry blossom trees...! I can't believe they're this close to our school...!

rows.Speaker: New Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, are you a new student too?
Wanna walk to school together?

rows.Speaker: New Student A
rows.Line: O-Okay, sure! I actually felt a little scared about going all alone so...

rows.Speaker: New Student B
rows.Line: Then I'm glad we met! I hope we're in the same class too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, they're new. That's why I didn't recognize them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They say spring's a time for meeting new people...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But even if you do, they all just...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Look, they're all blooming! They're so pretty! Why can't they just stay like this?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Well, at least they'll be here again next year.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yup! We can come back together even after we graduate.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Haha. Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? But I guess there's no getting rid of you either.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, we're thinking about seeing all the cherry blossoms later. Wanna come?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line: Don't worry. I went in knowing that I'd get turned down.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How can anyone think that they're this pretty?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How can these look so beautiful...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're just flowers in full bloom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not fair how they get to end this way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sort of understand what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They almost seem too pretty. It almost feels strange to think of them as plant life.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We have to struggle so much every day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Right. I get it now.
That's why they look so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're so pretty that it's unfair...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's a part of each of us that isn't really normal...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But that's also why we're together like this now...)
